description: This is a shell script (.sh) used as a test runner for building, patching, and testing a CMake-based project in a continuous integration environment. It manages patch application, ensures specific repository revisions, and runs build and test steps with optional code coverage reporting.

methods.name: apply_patch_idempotent
methods.description: Idempotently applies a patch to a target directory by checking if it applies cleanly or is already applied, avoiding rejections or conflicts.

methods.name: ensure_thundertools_expected_revision
methods.description: Pins the ThunderTools repository to a specific git revision (tag or commit) to ensure consistent environment for patch application.

methods.name: run_build_and_l1_tests
methods.description: Configures, builds, and tests the project using CMake and CTest, with optional code coverage report generation.

methods.name: ensure_repo_cloned
methods.description: Ensures a repository exists locally at a specified directory, cloning or updating it as necessary, and checking out the specified ref.

methods.name: ensure_l1_workflow_repos_present
methods.description: Clones required repositories for the L1-test workflow, such as Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, googletest, etc.
